description: Fizzy is the Kanban tracking tool for issues and ideas by 37signals: boards of cards that flow through columns, with comments, mentions, assignments and notifications. Kanban as it should be, not as it has been.
name: Fizzy
seoDescription: Deploy Fizzy with Docker Compose on Dokploy - 37signals' Kanban tool for tracking issues and ideas, as a single container with SQLite storage on a persistent volume.
